decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly reducing your own life total to power up Death's Shadow and Murktide Regent, while disrupting your opponent's game plan with a combination of hand disruption spells and counterspells. The deck aims to control the board with powerful threats and efficient removal spells, while utilizing card draw and manipulation to find the right answers at the right time. The mana base is optimized for fetching the necessary dual lands and Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base.

This UWx Control deck focuses on utilizing powerful planeswalkers like Jace, the Mind Sculptor and Teferi, Time Raveler to control the game and shut down opponent's strategies. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and counter spells like Force of Will and Force of Negation to keep opponents at bay. With a mix of card draw, removal spells like Swords to Plowshares, and win conditions like Shark Typhoon, this deck aims to control the board and outvalue opponents in the long game.

The deck focuses on utilizing the graveyard as a resource to quickly fill the battlefield with creatures. By dredging cards like Golgari Grave-Troll and Stinkweed Imp, the player can quickly generate an overwhelming board presence. Cards like Bridge from Below and Narcomoeba allow for additional value when creatures are put into the graveyard. The deck also includes disruption tools like Cabal Therapy to disrupt the opponent's game plan. With careful resource management and efficient milling, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a flood of creatures from the graveyard.

The main focus of this deck is to generate a large amount of mana quickly using efficient rituals and mana rocks like Lion's Eye Diamond and Lotus Petal, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Duress. The deck aims to assemble a critical mass of spells to cast Tendrils of Agony or utilize Burning Wish to find a lethal finisher like Past in Flames. The deck also includes cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder to filter through the deck and find combo pieces efficiently.

This deck focuses on generating mana quickly with elves and using that mana to power out powerful threats such as Grist, the Hunger Tide and Craterhoof Behemoth. The key strategy is to ramp up quickly, draw cards with Glimpse of Nature, and tutor for key pieces with Green Sun's Zenith and Natural Order. The deck has a strong toolbox of creatures and lands to adapt to different board states and opponent strategies. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and game-ending combos.

The deck focuses on using the Bomberman combo, consisting of Auriok Salvagers and Lion's Eye Diamond, to generate infinite mana and recycle valuable cards from the graveyard. Karn, the Great Creator acts as a versatile tool to tutor artifacts and lockdown opponents. Thought-Knot Seer disrupts opponents' strategies while Walking Ballista provides a win condition. Chalice of the Void helps stall opponents and disrupt their game plan. The deck aims to control the board and assemble its combo pieces efficiently to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the Elvish creatures and mana acceleration provided by cards like Heritage Druid, Nettle Sentinel, and Gaea's Cradle to quickly generate an overwhelming board presence. Glimpse of Nature and Green Sun's Zenith help draw into key pieces, while Natural Order can be used to tutor for Craterhoof Behemoth for a game-winning attack. The deck focuses on combo potential and explosive plays, aiming to overwhelm the opponent with a large swarm of Elves and powerful abilities.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying threats such as Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent while disrupting the opponent with counterspells like Daze and Force of Will. The deck also includes efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning to control the board. The mana base is optimized for consistency with fetch lands and dual lands. The key strategy is to apply pressure early, disrupt the opponent's game plan, and close out the game quickly with powerful threats.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying threats like Delver of Secrets and Murktide Regent while controlling the board with counterspells like Force of Will and Daze. By disrupting the opponent's game plan and applying pressure with efficient creatures and burn spells like Lightning Bolt, the deck aims to win the game before the opponent can stabilize. The mana base is designed to maximize consistency and provide access to all necessary colors. Overall, the deck aims to be proactive, disruptive, and versatile in order to secure a swift victory.

The main idea of this Legacy deck is to utilize a variety of artifact cards to quickly generate value and pressure the opponent with strong aggro plays. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Sai, Master Thopterist provide synergy with artifacts like Chalice of the Void, Lotus Petal, and Mox Opal, while powerful cards like Thought Monitor and Thoughtcast help draw into more threats. The deck aims to control the board with counterspells like Force of Will while efficiently ramping up with mana sources like Ancient Tomb and Urza's Saga.

The deck focuses on aggressive creature-based strategies combined with disruptive elements to control the opponent's game plan. It utilizes various hatebears like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Spirit of the Labyrinth to slow down the opponent while deploying efficient threats like Stoneforge Mystic and Skyclave Apparition. The deck also utilizes the flicker ability of cards like Flickerwisp and Solitude to provide additional value and disruption. The goal is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while putting pressure on them with efficient creatures to secure the win.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly assemble and cast a Doomsday pile to win the game with Thassa's Oracle. The deck uses a combination of tutors, cantrips, and disruption cards to find and protect the combo pieces. The inclusion of cards like Personal Tutor and Street Wraith allows for a streamlined and consistent win condition. The deck aims to disrupt opponents' game plans while quickly executing its own game plan to achieve victory through a powerful combo finish.
